result:
PR opened: **https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/591**

Summary of what was built (all 3 gaps confirmed absent by direct code inspection first, per the spec's verify-first requirement):

1. **Tiered SLA policy + team routing** — new `ticketTeams`/`slaPolicies`/`escalationRules`/`businessHoursSchedules`/`ticketEscalationEvents` tables, `tickets.teamId`/`slaPolicyId`/`requesterEmail` columns. `createTicket()` now resolves SLA from the most-specific matching active policy when no manual `slaHours` override is given — the legacy manual path is untouched. Escalation firing is wired into the existing metric-alerts cron (no new cron enabled). 10 pure-function tests pass (policy specificity scoring + business-hours deadline math, including weekend rollover).

2. **Email-to-ticket** — `createTicketFromEmailIntelligenceItem()` promotes an existing `emailIntelligenceItems` row straight into a real ticket, reusing that email-ingestion record rather than building a second pipeline.

3. **Public self-service portal** — `knowledgeBasePages.isPublished` flag, plus a new `public-portal-service.ts` that resolves an org by its existing public `slug` and lets an anonymous caller browse published KB pages and raise a ticket (routed to the org's default team, self-issued via the existing `conversationGuestAccess` mechanism), rate-limited the same way `org-join-code-service.ts` already rate-limits its own public endpoint.

Honestly disclosed in PROGRESS.md and the PR: full-project `tsc --noEmit` OOM'd in this sandbox and couldn't be completed (CI will need to confirm), `get_advisors(security)` couldn't run (no live Supabase MCP connection this session), and the new migration hasn't been applied to any real database yet. Registered the task claim in `ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml` before starting; per AGENTS.md the PR needs an independent auditor's `AUDIT: PASS/FAIL` comment before merge since this session can't self-certify.
